program.name: Cage Strength
program.subject: Fighter
program.blurb: Bouts, then strength in supersets: pull and push one day, legs and hips the next.
program.about: Strength for the clinch and the scramble. Each day opens with bouts, then supersets with weights: rows paired with presses and carries one day, squats paired with hinges and adductor work the next. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Bouts & pull-push supersets / bouts & lower supersets
